n feeling a need to see others suffer
n malevolence by virtue of being malicious or spiteful or nasty
v hurt the feelings of
words.ex: In spite of everything, I think it's not bad.
words.exz: 不论如何，我认为它不错。
words.fm: 现在分词:spiting|过去式:spited|第三人称单数:spites|过去分词:spited
words.ph: in spite of 尽管|out of spite 出于恶意
words.mn: 族:spiteful adj. 恶意的
words.dis:
【学习要点】
in spite of 后接名词、动名词或 the fact that，不直接接普通从句。

words.cn: v. 编织；编造、组织；迂回穿行。n. 织法、编织式样。
words.en:
n. pattern of weaving or structure of a fabric
v. interlace by or as if by weaving
v. create a piece of cloth by interlacing strands of fabric, such as wool or cotton
v. to move or cause to move in a sinuous, spiral, or circular course
words.ex: Spiders like to weave webs.
words.exz: 蜘蛛喜欢织网。
words.fm: 过去式:wove|过去分词:woven|现在分词:weaving|第三人称单数:weaves|迂回行进义也可见:weaved
words.ph: weave A into B 将A编入B|weave through 穿梭于
words.dis:
【学习要点】
过去式 wove，过去分词 woven；部分“穿行”用法也见 weaved。

words.cn: n. 机智、风趣；机智的人；（复数）理智、头脑。
words.en: n. a message whose ingenuity or verbal skill or incongruity has the power to evoke laughter
words.ex: Her wit made the conversation enjoyable.
words.exz: 她的机智使谈话很愉快。
words.fm: 名词复数:wits
words.ph: at one's wits' end 束手无策|a witty remark 诙谐的话
words.mn: 族:witty adj. 机智幽默的
words.dis:
【学习要点】
wit 表机智通常不可数；a wit 指一个风趣的人。
